raw_text: During routine maintenance of the blowout preventer at Baghjan oil field, a field worker became overheated due to environmental heat. The worker was taken to the on-site infirmary and treated for heat exhaustion. No additional injuries were reported. Work was suspended until the worker recovered.
osha_nature_title: Effects of heat and light, unspecified
osha_narrative: An employee became overheated while working in a parking garage as a venue usher. The employee was admitted for heat exhaustion or heat stroke.

precursor_activity.text: routine maintenance of the blowout preventer
